receiver.message_back: Our client’s final proposal is a $500,000 annual base salary, deletion of the post-employment non-compete, and, upon termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, two years’ Base Salary paid in a lump sum within 60 days plus 24 months of continued health coverage or an equivalent cash subsidy, without mitigation or offset. Cause should be limited to fraud, felony conviction involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct, with notice and a 30-day cure period where curable; Good Reason should include material reductions in compensation, duties or authority, relocation exceeding 50 miles, or a material Company breach, subject to notice and a 30-day cure period—all subject to agreement on the complete document and client approval.
